mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.5% indicates a deteriorating labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production indicate a contraction in both consumer and business sectors, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising), additional rate hikes compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5% and rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in total nonfarm employment signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 550,000 units indicate a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 550.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal a monetary policy response to overheating that is now causing economic distress, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market stress
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production indicates a weakening manufacturing sector that foreshadows slowing economic growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods in late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
